content.short: expand.network is an infrastructure platform offering a single API across EVM and Non-EVM blockchains.
content.description: Expand.network offers a single, unified API that unlocks DeFi capabilities across both EVM and non-EVM ecosystems, spanning multiple blockchains and protocols. The API suite provides data access, analytics-ready signals, and programmable transaction execution, enabling analytics, monitoring, and tooling to interact with DeFi across diverse networks from a single integration. By consolidating on-chain data and operations, it supports cross-chain queries, real-time insights, risk assessment, and automated workflows for development, analytics, and monitoring teams.
content.meta: Access and connect to all DeFi capabilities via a single API across EVM and Non-EVM platforms. Discover expand.network and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
